description: This file defines the 'Activity' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Event' namespace. The class extends the base controller and contains methods to log customer and affiliate activities such as add, edit, reset password, login, address changes, transactions, returns, etc. The methods are primarily used as event handlers triggered after specific actions, and they record activity data if the configuration setting 'config_customer_activity' is enabled.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Controller class handling customer and affiliate activity logging in response to various events, such as customer registration, password reset, login, address updates, transaction completions, etc.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: This class handles the logging of various customer activities, including order updates, address changes, password resets, registration, transaction, return, and affiliate activities, triggered by specific events within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Logs a customer registration activity if enabled in configuration, recording customer ID and name.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Logs a customer profile edit activity, capturing current customer ID and name.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Logs a password change activity; logs by customer ID if customer is logged in or by email look-up if not.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs login activity for specific routes if enabled, capturing customer ID and name.

methods.name: forgotten
methods.description: Logs forgotten password activity based on email email lookup if enabled.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Logs a transaction activity, recording customer ID, name, and order ID.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Logs return activity for a customer, including the customer ID, name, and return ID.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Logs address addition activity with customer ID and name.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Logs address modification activity with customer ID and name.

methods.name: deleteAddress
methods.description: Logs address deletion activity with customer ID and name.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Logs adding an affiliate with customer ID and name.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Logs editing an affiliate with customer ID and name.
